name: Grenade Game
summary: Grenade Game is an action packed PvP game where your only weapon is the grenade launcher, with many different types of grenades you can use to dominate the battlefield. With lots of different and completely unique maps of all shapes and sizes, and unique events that happen on different maps. A competitive gamemode to keep you busy and rule the servers, with rewards given for winning.
